entities.name: Alex Agase
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexander Arrasi Agase was an American professional football guard and linebacker who was named an All-American three times in college and played on three Cleveland Browns championship teams before becoming head football coach at Northwestern University and Purdue University.
